title: Support for Netgear/Sierra 770S AirCard 4G Mobile Hotspot
body:
This device has a full-size SIM slot, option for 2× external antennas, and a color LCD touchscreen.

I am unsure of the specs (processor, ram, OS, etc.). Here are some references:

- https://www.downloads.netgear.com/files/aircard/4112754%20AirCard%2077xS%20User%20Guide%20v2%20-%20webready.pdf
- https://www.4gltemall.com/sierra-770s-wireless-aircard-4g-mobile-hotspot.html

I can help test the device if necessary.
